text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! Happy & Great &
Bonjour & A Happy New Year!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right at the start of the new year, Seeking the Pearl burst energetically into the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This year is finally the Classic Class! Fitting for the start of such a fabulous year—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's Lunchbox!
That's right, I'm going to make osechi produced by me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Since we have the chance, let's gather volunteers
and make osechi for each other!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We'll each cook themed osechi dishes
and show them off to each other!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, an impromptu Osechi-making event hosted by Seeking the Pearl was organized—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi! The theme for today's osechi is none other than "Osechi for the World"!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That's the perfect theme for El,
the one aiming to be the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna do my best to make osechi that makes everyone in the world feel bono~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa, striving to become the "Monster Bird" that soars across the world, and Hishi Akebono, the foreign-born big-hearted master chef—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Joined by Seeking the Pearl and two others perfect for the theme,
everyone decided to try their hand at making osechi.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's osechi is complete, desu! You wrap the osechi
in tacos and dip them into salsa vida
before eating, desu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Mine's done too! Chinese, Italian, French... I put a little bit of cuisine from all over the world into the osechi~!"
choice_data_list: Oh, amazing job, both of you! Looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, revolutionary ideas that transcend the boundaries of traditional osechi—bravo to both of you!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then me too! This is the Pearl-style
"Worldwide Osechi" to be shared with the world!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Open the multi-tiered bento box!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From datemaki sweet rolled omelet to black soybeans, herring roe, and candied sardines—Seeking the Pearl's tiered bento box was packed full of classic New Year's dishes.
choice_data_list: A-An orthodox style, of all things...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is so elaborate~!
This candied chestnut mash has such a gorgeous color!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! As expected of Akebono!
I colored it using gardenia seeds.
I peeled the chestnuts and made the candied chestnuts from scratch too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What I was most particular about was the broth!
I soaked the kombu to make the stock, and even shaved the bonito flakes with a knife—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I also packed in plenty of my own special touches
and cooked it all with utmost care!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It certainly looks delicious! But...
Pearl-senpai, is this really the "Osechi to Share with the World"...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's a natural question. Of course,
arranging osechi like those two did so people around the world
can easily enjoy it is a wonderful approach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Still, I wanted to properly make the osechi dishes we usually eat, and serve them just the way they are."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, Poppy and Mommy took me along
to enjoy living in all kinds of countries!
And out of all of that, my absolute favorite thing was—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Try out the local soul food!
You can feel the energy of the land and truly connect with the locals' feelings!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Osechi is packed with passion and wisdom passed down from long ago, too.
You could call it "Japan's regional bento"!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I want them to taste those regional Japanese bentos,
the very soul of Japan, just as it is!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We'll show them what only we have,
and make them understand our charm!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is what I call
'Global Osechi Communication'!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Woooow!! I see!
As expected of Pearl-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That's so like you to think that way, Pearl-san~! This osechi and your thoughtful feelings are both truly buono!♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for innovation while cherishing tradition.
Listening to Seeking the Pearl's passion,
her osechi seemed to shine brilliantly."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now Trainer, it's tasting time♪
Enjoy the osechi! Bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with such a lavish osechi spread, I can hardly choose.
Which one should I eat first...
choice_data_list: Kelp rolls to wish for victory.
Black beans to wish for good health.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What a lovely choice!
Kombu rolls bring good fortune and joy, you know!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's run, win, and rejoice this year!
Run, win, and joy-joy-joy!
Now, repeat after me!!
choice_data_list: Run, win, and easy-peasy lemon squeezy...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!! My soul is on fire!
Once we finish eating, first run on the track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the osechi cooking class swiftly turned
into a workout session.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Choosing black soybeans, how amazing!!
They carry the wish of
'being able to work hard and live diligently'!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For such hard-working days,
vacations and holidays are super important too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it's gotta be a Sleepy New Year!
After we eat, we roll out the futon for a siesta!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we spent a relaxing start to the new year,
even taking a nice nap together.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Choosing the sweet rolled omelet is so cool!
It carries a passionate message wishing
for success in one's studies!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If a fabulous person like me studies even more,
it'll truly be like giving a demon a morningstar!
choice_data_list: So it's like giving an ogre an iron club...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're quite intelligent too!
In that case, I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After enjoying the osechi, I spent an unusual New Year's Day engrossed in encyclopedias at the library.
